_about: Magic school life, house rivalries, and buried campus secrets. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

campus: a spire of bridged towers tethered to a storm cloud
a sunken coral conservatory lit by bottled tide-lanterns
a desert observatory built inside an hourglass crater
a sprawling hall grown inside the roots of a petrified cedar
an endless sleeper-train collegium that never stops at one border
a snowbound fortress warmed by bound salamander furnaces
a canal-city university where gondolas ferry students between faculties
a soot-stained foundry school hammering runes into living brass
curriculum: star-charting and the arithmetic of omens
true-name calligraphy brushed onto silk talismans
faction: exhausted scholarship grinders hoarding past exam papers
old-blood dueling aristocrats with matching silver capes
midnight rooftop astronomers mapping illegal constellations
basement potion brewers trading contraband focus tonics
prefect wardens who bend curfew rules for their friends
a dead-language circle translating banned margin notes
remedial misfits exiled to the dampest cellar dormitory
key-runners smuggling freshmen through forgotten service stairs
authority: a smiling dean who hears every lie spoken under the bell tower
an immortal catalog-keeper chained willingly to the rare stacks
a scarred dueling instructor teaching under a borrowed name
porcelain courtyard hounds that hunt anyone out past midnight
class rankings burned onto the dining hall ceiling every Monday
wealthy trustees pressuring the school to train war-casters
a gruff groundskeeper hiding expelled apprentices in the greenhouse
an ancient school charter that strips magic from oath-breakers
trouble: last year's top graduate vanished during the final practical trial
a bricked-up dormitory wing started humming lullabies at dusk
someone is selling cheated exam charms that quietly eat memories

practice wands are misfiring with wild, unseasonal storms
a delegation from a rival academy arrived three months too early

stakes: expulsion sends your family straight back to debtors' court
winning the winter cup clears an ugly favor owed to a senior
keeping your scholarship demands top-ten marks before frostfall
failing probation means the faculty binds your casting hand
something locked beneath the amphitheater already knows your name
your closest roommate made a reckless pact just to pass midterms
exposing the faculty cover-up disgraces the house that sheltered you
graduation forces every apprentice to swear loyalty to a patron

1: a classroom mishap leaves behind proof of tampered wards
a rival house plants contraband before a surprise dorm inspection

2: midterm trials turn hazardous when safety seals fail on purpose

3: campus goes under lockdown as the board sends outside enforcers

4: the sealed vault beneath the campus breaks open during final exams
students must unite rival houses to stand against corrupt leadership
rewriting the founding charter demands a sacrifice nobody taught in class
graduating intact means facing the thing the school was built to cage
